<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Crafty Watts — Handmade with Love</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Quicksand:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg: #fff3f6;
    --card: #fffdfe;
    --pink: #ffb9cf;
    --pink-soft: #ffe2ea;
    --rose: #e2547e;
    --rose-deep: #c73a63;
    --ink: #4a2e39;
    --ink-soft: #8a6b74;
    --cream: #fff9f4;
    --gold: #f4c869;
    --radius: 22px;
    --shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(199, 58, 99, 0.14);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,.display{
    font-family:'Baloo 2', cursive;
    font-weight:700;
    margin:0;
    color:var(--rose-deep);
  }
  p{line-height:1.65;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
  button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;}
  img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%;}
  .wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;}

  /* background paw pattern */
  .paw-bg{
    position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
    background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(226,84,126,0.06) 2.5px, transparent 2.5px);
    background-size: 34px 34px;
  }

  /* ===== Header ===== */
  header{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
    background:rgba(255,243,246,0.9);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--pink-soft);
  }
  .nav{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    padding:16px 28px;max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;
  }
  .logo{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    font-family:'Baloo 2',cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--rose-deep);
  }
  .logo .bow{width:34px;height:34px;}
  .navlinks{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;}
  .navlinks button{
    background:none;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;
    font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);font-size:0.98rem;
    transition:background .2s, color .2s;
  }
  .navlinks button.active,.navlinks button:hover{background:var(--pink-soft);color:var(--rose-deep);}
  .cart-btn{
    position:relative;background:var(--rose);color:#fff;
    padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(226,84,126,0.35);
    transition:transform .15s;
  }
  .cart-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .cart-count{
    background:#fff;color:var(--rose-deep);border-radius:999px;
    font-size:0.75rem;min-width:20px;height:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 5px;font-weight:800;
  }
  .mobile-toggle{display:none;background:none;padding:8px;}

  /* ===== Sections generic ===== */
  section{padding:72px 0;}
  .eyebrow{color:var(--rose);font-weight:700;font-size:0.95rem;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
  .eyebrow .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);}

  /* ===== Hero ===== */
  .hero{padding-top:56px;padding-bottom:40px;overflow:hidden;}
  .hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 0.95fr;gap:50px;align-items:center;}
  .hero h1{font-size:3.2rem;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-0.5px;}
  .hero h1 .script{
    display:inline-block;color:var(--rose);
    position:relative;
  }
  .hero p.lead{font-size:1.12rem;margin:22px 0 30px;max-width:440px;}
  .hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .btn-primary{
    background:var(--rose);color:#fff;padding:15px 28px;border-radius:999px;
    font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(226,84,126,0.32);
    transition:transform .15s;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .btn-ghost{
    background:#fff;color:var(--rose-deep);padding:15px 26px;border-radius:999px;
    font-weight:700;border:2px solid var(--pink-soft);transition:border-color .15s;
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--pink);}
  .hero-stats{display:flex;gap:30px;margin-top:38px;}
  .hero-stats div strong{display:block;font-family:'Baloo 2';font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--rose-deep);}
  .hero-stats div span{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}

  .hero-art{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .blob{
    position:absolute;width:420px;height:420px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 30%, #ffd6e2, var(--pink) 70%);
    filter:blur(0px);
  }
  .hero-card{
    position:relative;background:var(--card);border-radius:28px;padding:26px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);width:300px;transform:rotate(-3deg);
  }
  .hero-card .ribbon{
    position:absolute;top:-14px;right:22px;background:var(--gold);color:#5c4300;
    font-weight:800;font-size:0.78rem;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;
    box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(244,200,105,0.5);
  }
  .paw-icon{width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto 14px;}
  .hero-card h3{text-align:center;font-size:1.15rem;}
  .hero-card p{text-align:center;font-size:0.88rem;margin:6px 0 0;}
  .float-badge{
    position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:12px 16px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:0.85rem;
  }
  .float-badge.b1{top:6%;left:-4%;}
  .float-badge.b2{bottom:8%;right:-8%;}
  .float-badge .emoji-dot{
    width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink-soft);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1rem;
  }

  /* ===== Marquee strip ===== */
  .strip{
    background:var(--rose);color:#fff;padding:13px 0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .strip-track{display:inline-flex;gap:40px;animation:scroll 26s linear infinite;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.3px;}
  .strip-track span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
  @keyframes scroll{from{transform:translateX(0);}to{transform:translateX(-50%);}}

  /* ===== Category cards ===== */
  .section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:36px;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .section-head h2{font-size:2.1rem;}
  .cat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;}
  .cat-card{
    background:var(--card);border-radius:20px;padding:26px 20px;text-align:center;
    box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(199,58,99,0.08);transition:transform .18s, box-shadow .18s;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .cat-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  .cat-icon{
    width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink-soft);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 14px;font-size:1.6rem;
  }
  .cat-card h3{font-size:1.02rem;}
  .cat-card p{font-size:0.82rem;margin-top:4px;}

  /* ===== Product grid ===== */
  .filters{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:30px;}
  .chip{
    background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--pink-soft);padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;
    font-weight:700;font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--ink);transition:.15s;
  }
  .chip.active,.chip:hover{background:var(--rose);border-color:var(--rose);color:#fff;}
  .prod-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px;}
  .prod-card{
    background:var(--card);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(199,58,99,0.08);transition:transform .18s, box-shadow .18s;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  }
  .prod-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  .prod-media{
    aspect-ratio:1/0.95;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-size:2.6rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .prod-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .prod-media .icon-badge{
    position:absolute;bottom:12px;right:12px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;
    background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.1rem;
    box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  }
  .prod-tag{
    position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;background:#fff;color:var(--rose-deep);
    font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:800;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;
  }
  .prod-body{padding:16px 18px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1;}
  .prod-body h3{font-size:1rem;font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);}
  .prod-body .desc{font-size:0.82rem;margin:0;flex:1;}
  .prod-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:6px;}
  .price{font-family:'Baloo 2';color:var(--rose-deep);font-size:1.12rem;}
  .add-btn{
    background:var(--pink-soft);color:var(--rose-deep);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;
    font-size:1.3rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;
    transition:background .15s, color .15s, transform .15s;
  }
  .add-btn:hover{background:var(--rose);color:#fff;transform:scale(1.08);}

  /* ===== About ===== */
  .about-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:0.85fr 1.15fr;gap:56px;align-items:center;}
  .about-photo{
    background:linear-gradient(155deg, var(--pink) 0%, var(--rose) 100%);
    border-radius:28px;aspect-ratio:1/1.05;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .about-photo .paw-icon{width:130px;height:130px;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.12));}
  .about-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:24px 0 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
  .about-list li{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);}
  .about-list .num{
    background:var(--pink-soft);color:var(--rose-deep);width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:0.85rem;font-family:'Baloo 2';flex-shrink:0;
  }

  /* ===== Testimonial / trust strip ===== */
  .trust{background:var(--cream);}
  .trust-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;}
  .trust-card{background:var(--card);border-radius:20px;padding:26px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(199,58,99,0.06);}
  .trust-card .stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:2px;}
  .trust-card p{font-size:0.92rem;color:var(--ink);}
  .trust-card .who{margin-top:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--rose-deep);font-size:0.88rem;}

  /* ===== Contact ===== */
  .contact-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:0.9fr 1.1fr;gap:50px;}
  .contact-info-card{
    background:var(--rose);color:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:36px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .contact-info-card h3{color:#fff;font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .contact-info-card p{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.88);}
  .contact-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:20px;font-weight:700;}
  .contact-row .ic{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.18);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .form-card{background:var(--card);border-radius:28px;padding:32px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(199,58,99,0.08);}
  .field{margin-bottom:16px;}
  .field label{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:0.88rem;margin-bottom:7px;color:var(--ink);}
  .field input,.field textarea{
    width:100%;padding:13px 16px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid var(--pink-soft);
    font-family:inherit;font-size:0.95rem;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);
    transition:border-color .15s;
  }
  .field input:focus,.field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--rose);}
  .field textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:100px;}
  .form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;}

  /* ===== Footer ===== */
  footer{background:#3a2530;color:#f6dde5;padding:50px 0 24px;margin-top:20px;}
  .foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;margin-bottom:36px;}
  footer h4{color:#fff;font-family:'Baloo 2';margin-bottom:14px;font-size:1.05rem;}
  footer .logo{color:#fff;}
  footer p{color:#cba3ae;font-size:0.9rem;}
  .foot-links{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
  .foot-links a{color:#e6bfca;font-size:0.9rem;transition:color .15s;}
  .foot-links a:hover{color:#fff;}
  .foot-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);padding-top:20px;text-align:center;font-size:0.82rem;color:#a07d89;}

  /* ===== Cart drawer ===== */
  .overlay{
    position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(74,46,57,0.42);z-index:90;
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s;
  }
  .overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}
  .cart-drawer{
    position:fixed;top:0;right:-420px;width:400px;max-width:92vw;height:100%;
    background:var(--bg);z-index:95;box-shadow:-14px 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    transition:right .3s ease;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  }
  .cart-drawer.open{right:0;}
  .cart-head{
    padding:22px 24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--pink-soft);background:var(--card);
  }
  .cart-head h3{font-size:1.3rem;}
  .close-btn{
    background:var(--pink-soft);width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--rose-deep);
  }
  .cart-items{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:18px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
  .cart-empty{text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .cart-empty .paw-icon{width:56px;height:56px;margin:0 auto 14px;opacity:0.5;}
  .cart-item{
    background:var(--card);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;
    box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(199,58,99,0.07);
  }
  .ci-media{
    width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--pink-soft);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.5rem;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .ci-body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .ci-body h4{font-size:0.9rem;margin:0 0 2px;font-weight:700;}
  .ci-body .ci-price{font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--rose-deep);font-weight:700;}
  .qty-ctrl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:6px;}
  .qty-ctrl button{
    width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink-soft);color:var(--rose-deep);
    font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:0.9rem;
  }
  .qty-ctrl span{font-weight:700;font-size:0.88rem;min-width:16px;text-align:center;}
  .remove-btn{background:none;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:0.78rem;text-decoration:underline;margin-top:4px;}
  .cart-foot{padding:20px 24px 26px;border-top:1px solid var(--pink-soft);background:var(--card);}
  .cart-total-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px;font-size:1.05rem;}
  .cart-total-row span:last-child{color:var(--rose-deep);font-family:'Baloo 2';}
  .checkout-btn{width:100%;background:var(--rose);color:#fff;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:800;font-size:1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;}
  .checkout-note{font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:center;margin-top:10px;}

  .toast{
    position:fixed;bottom:26px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);
    background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:0.9rem;
    z-index:110;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s, transform .25s;
    box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  }
  .toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}

  .page{display:none;}
  .page.active{display:block;}

  /* ===== Stock badges (shop cards) ===== */
  .stock-tag{
    position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:12px;font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:800;
    padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;
  }
  .stock-tag.low{color:#b5541b;background:#fff0dd;}
  .stock-tag.out{color:#9c3a3a;background:#ffe1e1;}
  .prod-card.disabled{opacity:0.55;}
  .add-btn[disabled]{opacity:0.4;pointer-events:none;}

  /* ===== Checkout page ===== */
  .checkout-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 0.85fr;gap:44px;align-items:flex-start;}
  .checkout-steps{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:30px;font-weight:700;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .checkout-steps .step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
  .checkout-steps .step .n{
    width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink-soft);color:var(--rose-deep);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'Baloo 2';font-size:0.8rem;
  }
  .checkout-steps .step.done .n{background:var(--rose);color:#fff;}
  .checkout-steps .sep{width:24px;height:2px;background:var(--pink-soft);}
  .co-card{background:var(--card);border-radius:24px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(199,58,99,0.08);}
  .co-card h3{font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .co-summary-item{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--pink-soft);}
  .co-summary-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .co-summary-item .media{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.3rem;flex-shrink:0;}
  .co-summary-item .body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .co-summary-item .body h4{font-size:0.9rem;margin:0;font-weight:700;}
  .co-summary-item .body span{font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .co-summary-item .line-total{font-weight:700;color:var(--rose-deep);font-size:0.9rem;}
  .co-totals{margin-top:16px;padding-top:16px;border-top:2px dashed var(--pink-soft);}
  .co-totals-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .co-totals-row.grand{font-weight:800;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--ink);margin-top:10px;}
  .co-totals-row.grand span:last-child{color:var(--rose-deep);font-family:'Baloo 2';}
  .co-empty{text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .payment-note{
    background:var(--pink-soft);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:0.82rem;
    color:var(--rose-deep);font-weight:600;margin-top:18px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;
  }
  .field-error{border-color:#d6486b !important;}
  .error-text{color:#c73a63;font-size:0.76rem;margin-top:5px;display:none;font-weight:700;}
  .error-text.show{display:block;}

  @media(max-width:860px){
    .checkout-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }

  /* ===== Thank-you overlay ===== */
  .thankyou-overlay{
    position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(74,46,57,0.5);z-index:200;
    display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
  }
  .thankyou-overlay.show{display:flex;}
  .thankyou-card{
    background:var(--bg);border-radius:28px;padding:44px 36px;max-width:420px;width:100%;
    text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .ty-icon{
    width:88px;height:88px;margin:0 auto 20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink-soft);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2.6rem;
    animation:ty-pop .55s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  }
  .ty-illustration{
    width:150px;height:auto;margin:-14px auto 6px;display:block;
    animation:ty-pop .6s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
    filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 16px rgba(199,58,99,0.18));
  }
  @keyframes ty-pop{
    0%{transform:scale(0);opacity:0;}
    60%{transform:scale(1.12);opacity:1;}
    100%{transform:scale(1);}
  }
  .thankyou-card h2{font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .thankyou-card p{margin-bottom:6px;}
  .ty-order-id{
    display:inline-block;background:var(--pink-soft);color:var(--rose-deep);font-weight:800;
    padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px;margin:14px 0 22px;font-family:'Baloo 2';letter-spacing:0.5px;
  }
  .ty-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
  .confetti-piece{
    position:absolute;top:-20px;width:9px;height:14px;border-radius:2px;
    animation-name:confetti-fall;animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1);animation-iteration-count:1;
  }
  @keyframes confetti-fall{
    0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);opacity:1;}
    100%{transform:translateY(420px) rotate(340deg);opacity:0;}
  }

  /* ===== Preloader ===== */
  #preloader{
    position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999;
    background:linear-gradient(165deg, #f28bb0 0%, #e2547e 100%);
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;
    transition:opacity .4s ease, visibility .4s ease;
  }
  #preloader.hide{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;}
  #preloader img{
    width:min(55vw, 200px);
    filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.22));
    animation:preloader-pop .7s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) both, preloader-bob 2.2s ease-in-out .7s infinite;
  }
  @keyframes preloader-pop{
    0%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:0;}
    100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}
  }
  @keyframes preloader-bob{
    0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}
    50%{transform:translateY(-10px);}
  }
  .preloader-dots{display:flex;gap:8px;}
  .preloader-dots span{
    width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;
    animation:preloader-dot 1s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .preloader-dots span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s;}
  .preloader-dots span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s;}
  @keyframes preloader-dot{
    0%,80%,100%{opacity:.35;transform:translateY(0);}
    40%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-5px);}
  }
  #preloader .pl-text{color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:0.9rem;letter-spacing:0.3px;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    #preloader img{animation:preloader-pop .3s ease both;}
    .preloader-dots span{animation:none;opacity:0.8;}
  }

  /* ===== Sync banner ===== */
  .sync-banner{
    background:var(--gold);color:#5c4300;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-size:0.82rem;
    padding:9px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  }
  .sync-banner.hide{display:none;}
  .sync-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#5c4300;animation:sync-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes sync-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:0.35;}50%{opacity:1;}}



  @media(max-width:980px){
    .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .hero-art{order:-1;margin-bottom:10px;}
    .cat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .prod-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .about-wrap,.contact-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .trust-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px;}
    .navlinks{display:none;position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:var(--bg);flex-direction:column;padding:14px 28px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--pink-soft);}
    .navlinks.open{display:flex;}
    .mobile-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
    .hero h1{font-size:2.3rem;}
  }
  @media(max-width:640px){
    .form-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{animation:none !important;transition:none !important;}
  }
</style>
</head>

<script>
  const WHATSAPP_NUMBER = "923XXXXXXXXX"; // replace with real number, country code no + or 00

  const PRODUCTS = [
    {id:1, name:"Custom Photo Gift Box", cat:"gifts", price:1800, icon:"🎁", tag:"Bestseller", desc:"A personalised box with photos, notes & little surprises inside.", stock:8},
    {id:2, name:"Hand-Painted Frame", cat:"painted", price:1400, icon:"🖼️", tag:"Popular", desc:"Your chosen quote or design, hand-painted onto a wooden frame.", stock:5},
    {id:3, name:"Kiss Keepsake Jar", cat:"keepsakes", price:900, icon:"💋", tag:"Signature", desc:"Our little \"kisses\" jar — a sweet, customisable love note keepsake.", stock:3},
    {id:4, name:"Eid Mubarak Hamper", cat:"occasion", price:2400, icon:"🌙", tag:"Seasonal", desc:"A festive hamper with hand-painted décor and sweet treats.", stock:0},
    {id:5, name:"Resin Name Keychain", cat:"gifts", price:600, icon:"🔑", tag:null, desc:"A resin keychain personalised with a name or initial.", stock:14},
    {id:6, name:"Painted Wish Jar", cat:"painted", price:1100, icon:"🏺", tag:null, desc:"Fill it with little notes — hand-painted, made just for you.", stock:6},
    {id:7, name:"Love Letter Bouquet", cat:"keepsakes", price:1600, icon:"💌", tag:"New", desc:"A paper-flower bouquet with hidden love notes in every bloom.", stock:4},
    {id:8, name:"Birthday Surprise Box", cat:"occasion", price:2100, icon:"🎂", tag:null, desc:"A themed birthday box, customised around their favourite things.", stock:7},
    {id:9, name:"Hand-Painted Mug", cat:"painted", price:950, icon:"☕", tag:null, desc:"A ceramic mug hand-painted with a name, date or little doodle.", stock:2},
    {id:10, name:"Scrapbook Memory Book", cat:"gifts", price:1900, icon:"📔", tag:"Popular", desc:"A handmade scrapbook ready for your photos & memories.", stock:9},
    {id:12, name:"Mini Kiss Card Set", cat:"keepsakes", price:500, icon:"💗", tag:null, desc:"A set of tiny handmade cards, each with a sweet little note.", stock:16},
  ];

  const CATS = [
    {id:"all", label:"All"},
    {id:"gifts", label:"Custom Gift Boxes"},
    {id:"painted", label:"Hand-Painted"},
    {id:"keepsakes", label:"Kiss Keepsakes"},
    {id:"occasion", label:"Eid & Occasion"},
  ];

  let cart = []; // {id, qty}
  let activeFilter = "all";
  let ORDERS = [];
  const STORAGE_KEY_STOCK = "crafty-watts:stock";
  const STORAGE_KEY_ORDERS = "crafty-watts:orders";

  function fmt(n){ return "Rs. " + n.toLocaleString(); }

  function productCard(p){
    const out = p.stock<=0;
    const low = !out && p.stock<=3;
    const stockTag = out ? `<div class="stock-tag out">Out of stock</div>`
                    : low ? `<div class="stock-tag low">Only ${p.stock} left</div>`
                    : "";
    return `
      <div class="prod-card ${out?'disabled':''}">
        <div class="prod-media" style="background:${mediaColor(p.cat)}">
          ${p.tag ? `<div class="prod-tag">${p.tag}</div>` : ""}
          ${stockTag}
          <img src="https://picsum.photos/seed/craftywatts-${p.id}/460/460" alt="${p.name}" loading="lazy">
          <div class="icon-badge">${p.icon}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="prod-body">
          <h3>${p.name}</h3>
          <p class="desc">${p.desc}</p>
          <div class="prod-foot">
            <span class="price">${fmt(p.price)}</span>
            <button class="add-btn" onclick="addToCart(${p.id})" aria-label="Add to cart" ${out?'disabled':''}>+</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function mediaColor(cat){
    const map = {gifts:"#ffe2ea", painted:"#ffd6e2", keepsakes:"#ffc9d9", occasion:"#fff0d9"};
    return map[cat] || "#ffe2ea";
  }

  function renderHomeGrid(){
    const best = PRODUCTS.filter(p=>p.tag).slice(0,4);
    document.getElementById("homeProductGrid").innerHTML = best.map(productCard).join("");
  }

  function renderFilterChips(){
    document.getElementById("filterChips").innerHTML = CATS.map(c=>
      `<button class="chip ${c.id===activeFilter?'active':''}" onclick="filterCat('${c.id}')">${c.label}</button>`
    ).join("");
  }

  function renderShopGrid(){
    const list = activeFilter==="all" ? PRODUCTS : PRODUCTS.filter(p=>p.cat===activeFilter);
    document.getElementById("shopProductGrid").innerHTML = list.map(productCard).join("");
  }

  function filterCat(cat){
    activeFilter = cat;
    renderFilterChips();
    renderShopGrid();
  }

  function addToCart(id){
    const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(!p || p.stock<=0){ showToast("Sorry, that one's out of stock 💗"); return; }
    const existing = cart.find(i=>i.id===id);
    const inCart = existing ? existing.qty : 0;
    if(inCart+1 > p.stock){ showToast(`Only ${p.stock} in stock right now`); return; }
    if(existing){ existing.qty++; } else { cart.push({id, qty:1}); }
    renderCart();
    showToast(`${p.name} added to cart 🎀`);
  }

  function changeQty(id, delta){
    const item = cart.find(i=>i.id===id);
    if(!item) return;
    const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(delta>0 && item.qty+1>p.stock){ showToast(`Only ${p.stock} in stock right now`); return; }
    item.qty += delta;
    if(item.qty<=0){ cart = cart.filter(i=>i.id!==id); }
    renderCart();
    if(document.getElementById("page-checkout").classList.contains("active")) renderCheckout();
  }

  function removeItem(id){
    cart = cart.filter(i=>i.id!==id);
    renderCart();
    if(document.getElementById("page-checkout").classList.contains("active")) renderCheckout();
  }

  function cartTotal(){
    return cart.reduce((sum,i)=>{
      const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===i.id);
      return sum + p.price * i.qty;
    },0);
  }

  function renderCart(){
    const count = cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.qty,0);
    document.getElementById("cartCount").textContent = count;
    const itemsEl = document.getElementById("cartItems");
    if(cart.length===0){
      itemsEl.innerHTML = `
        <div class="cart-empty">
          <svg class="paw-icon" viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="none">
            <ellipse cx="32" cy="40" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#e2547e"/>
            <circle cx="14" cy="22" r="7" fill="#e2547e"/>
            <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="7" fill="#e2547e"/>
            <circle cx="24" cy="12" r="6.5" fill="#e2547e"/>
            <circle cx="40" cy="12" r="6.5" fill="#e2547e"/>
          </svg>
          Your cart is empty.<br>Add something sweet from the shop 💗
        </div>`;
    } else {
      itemsEl.innerHTML = cart.map(i=>{
        const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===i.id);
        return `
          <div class="cart-item">
            <div class="ci-media" style="background:${mediaColor(p.cat)}">${p.icon}</div>
            <div class="ci-body">
              <h4>${p.name}</h4>
              <div class="ci-price">${fmt(p.price)}</div>
              <div class="qty-ctrl">
                <button onclick="changeQty(${p.id},-1)">−</button>
                <span>${i.qty}</span>
                <button onclick="changeQty(${p.id},1)">+</button>
              </div>
              <button class="remove-btn" onclick="removeItem(${p.id})">Remove</button>
            </div>
          </div>`;
      }).join("");
    }
    document.getElementById("cartTotal").textContent = fmt(cartTotal());
  }

  function openCart(){
    document.getElementById("cartDrawer").classList.add("open");
    document.getElementById("overlay").classList.add("open");
  }
  function closeCart(){
    document.getElementById("cartDrawer").classList.remove("open");
    document.getElementById("overlay").classList.remove("open");
  }

  function goToCheckout(){
    if(cart.length===0){ showToast("Your cart is empty 💗"); return; }
    closeCart();
    goPage("checkout");
  }

  function renderCheckout(){
    const el = document.getElementById("checkoutContent");
    if(cart.length===0){
      el.innerHTML = `<div class="co-card" style="grid-column:1/-1;"><div class="co-empty">Your cart is empty.<br><button class="btn-primary" style="margin-top:16px;" onclick="goPage('shop')">Browse the shop</button></div></div>`;
      return;
    }
    const itemsHtml = cart.map(i=>{
      const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===i.id);
      return `
        <div class="co-summary-item">
          <div class="media" style="background:${mediaColor(p.cat)}">${p.icon}</div>
          <div class="body"><h4>${p.name}</h4><span>Qty ${i.qty} · ${fmt(p.price)} each</span></div>
          <div class="line-total">${fmt(p.price*i.qty)}</div>
        </div>`;
    }).join("");
    const total = cartTotal();
    el.innerHTML = `
      <div>
        <div class="co-card">
          <h3>Your delivery details</h3>
          <div class="form-row">
            <div class="field"><label>Full name</label><input id="coName" type="text" placeholder="e.g. Iman Fatima"><div class="error-text" id="err-coName">Please enter your name</div></div>
            <div class="field"><label>WhatsApp number</label><input id="coPhone" type="text" placeholder="03XX XXXXXXX"><div class="error-text" id="err-coPhone">Please enter a phone number</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="field"><label>Delivery address</label><input id="coAddress" type="text" placeholder="House / street, area, city"><div class="error-text" id="err-coAddress">Please enter a delivery address</div></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Customisation notes (optional)</label><textarea id="coNotes" placeholder="Names, colours, dates or any special request..."></textarea></div>
          <div class="payment-note">💳 We take advance payment only to confirm your order — we'll share payment details on WhatsApp once you place this order.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="co-card">
        <h3>Order summary</h3>
        ${itemsHtml}
        <div class="co-totals">
          <div class="co-totals-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span>${fmt(total)}</span></div>
          <div class="co-totals-row"><span>Delivery</span><span>Confirmed on WhatsApp</span></div>
          <div class="co-totals-row grand"><span>Total</span><span>${fmt(total)}</span></div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn-primary" style="width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:20px;" onclick="confirmOrder()">Confirm order</button>
      </div>`;
  }

  let lastOrder = null;

  function confirmOrder(){
    if(cart.length===0){ showToast("Your cart is empty 💗"); return; }
    const name = document.getElementById("coName");
    const phone = document.getElementById("coPhone");
    const address = document.getElementById("coAddress");
    const notes = document.getElementById("coNotes");
    let valid = true;
    [["coName",name],["coPhone",phone],["coAddress",address]].forEach(([key,field])=>{
      const bad = field.value.trim().length===0;
      field.classList.toggle("field-error", bad);
      document.getElementById("err-"+key).classList.toggle("show", bad);
      if(bad) valid=false;
    });
    if(!valid){ showToast("Please fill in the highlighted fields"); return; }

    // reduce stock
    cart.forEach(i=>{
      const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===i.id);
      p.stock = Math.max(0, p.stock - i.qty);
    });

    const orderId = "CW-" + Math.floor(1000 + Math.random()*9000);
    lastOrder = {
      id: orderId,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      name: name.value.trim(),
      phone: phone.value.trim(),
      address: address.value.trim(),
      notes: notes.value.trim(),
      items: cart.map(i=>({...PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===i.id), qty:i.qty})),
      total: cartTotal()
    };

    cart = [];
    renderCart();
    if(activeFilter) renderShopGrid();
    renderHomeGrid();

    ORDERS.unshift(lastOrder);
    saveStock();
    saveOrders();

    showThankYou(orderId);
  }

  function showThankYou(orderId){
    document.getElementById("tyOrderId").textContent = "#" + orderId;
    const overlay = document.getElementById("thankyouOverlay");
    overlay.classList.add("show");
    launchConfetti();
  }

  function closeThankYou(){
    document.getElementById("thankyouOverlay").classList.remove("show");
    goPage("home");
  }

  function sendFinalWhatsApp(){
    if(!lastOrder) return;
    let msg = `Hi Crafty Watts! Order ${lastOrder.id} confirmed on the site:%0A%0A`;
    lastOrder.items.forEach(it=>{
      msg += `• ${it.name} x${it.qty} — ${fmt(it.price*it.qty)}%0A`;
    });
    msg += `%0ATotal: ${fmt(lastOrder.total)}%0A%0AName: ${encodeURIComponent(lastOrder.name)}%0APhone: ${encodeURIComponent(lastOrder.phone)}%0AAddress: ${encodeURIComponent(lastOrder.address)}`;
    if(lastOrder.notes) msg += `%0ANotes: ${encodeURIComponent(lastOrder.notes)}`;
    window.open(`https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${msg}`, "_blank");
  }

  function launchConfetti(){
    const card = document.getElementById("thankyouCard");
    card.querySelectorAll(".confetti-piece").forEach(el=>el.remove());
    if(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    const colors = ["#e2547e","#ffb9cf","#f4c869","#fff9f4","#c73a63"];
    for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
      const piece = document.createElement("div");
      piece.className = "confetti-piece";
      piece.style.left = Math.random()*100 + "%";
      piece.style.background = colors[i % colors.length];
      piece.style.animationDuration = (1.1 + Math.random()*0.9) + "s";
      piece.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*0.3) + "s";
      piece.style.borderRadius = Math.random()>0.5 ? "50%" : "2px";
      card.appendChild(piece);
    }
  }

  function sendContactForm(){
    showToast("Thanks! We'll get back to you soon 💌");
  }

  // ===== Custom order page =====
  function renderCustomPage(){
    const grid = document.getElementById("customProductGrid");
    if(!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = PRODUCTS.map(p=>{
      const out = p.stock<=0;
      return `
        <div class="prod-card ${out?'disabled':''}">
          <div class="prod-media" style="background:${mediaColor(p.cat)}">
            ${p.tag ? `<div class="prod-tag">${p.tag}</div>` : ""}
            <img src="https://picsum.photos/seed/craftywatts-${p.id}/460/460" alt="${p.name}" loading="lazy">
            <div class="icon-badge">${p.icon}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="prod-body">
            <h3>${p.name}</h3>
            <p class="desc">${p.desc}</p>
            <div class="prod-foot">
              <span class="price">${fmt(p.price)}</span>
              <button class="btn-ghost" style="padding:9px 16px;font-size:0.85rem;" onclick="pickCustomProduct(${p.id})">Request this</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join("");

    const select = document.getElementById("cuProduct");
    if(select){
      select.innerHTML = `<option value="0">Something new / not listed here</option>` +
        PRODUCTS.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${p.name} — ${fmt(p.price)}</option>`).join("");
    }
  }

  function pickCustomProduct(id){
    const select = document.getElementById("cuProduct");
    if(select) select.value = id;
    const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===id);
    document.getElementById("customFormTitle").textContent = `Customising: ${p.name}`;
    document.querySelector(".co-card").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth", block:"start"});
    document.getElementById("cuDetails").focus({preventScroll:true});
  }

  function submitCustomOrder(){
    const name = document.getElementById("cuName");
    const phone = document.getElementById("cuPhone");
    const details = document.getElementById("cuDetails");
    const select = document.getElementById("cuProduct");
    let valid = true;
    [["cuName",name],["cuPhone",phone],["cuDetails",details]].forEach(([key,field])=>{
      const bad = field.value.trim().length===0;
      field.classList.toggle("field-error", bad);
      document.getElementById("err-"+key).classList.toggle("show", bad);
      if(bad) valid=false;
    });
    if(!valid){ showToast("Please fill in the highlighted fields"); return; }

    const chosen = select.options[select.selectedIndex].text;
    let msg = `Hi Crafty Watts! I'd love a custom order:%0A%0A`;
    msg += `Starting item: ${encodeURIComponent(chosen)}%0A`;
    msg += `What I'd like: ${encodeURIComponent(details.value.trim())}%0A%0A`;
    msg += `Name: ${encodeURIComponent(name.value.trim())}%0APhone: ${encodeURIComponent(phone.value.trim())}`;
    window.open(`https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${msg}`, "_blank");
    showToast("Opening WhatsApp to send your request 💌");
  }

  // ===== Persistent storage (shared across everyone who opens this site) =====
  async function initStorage(){
    if(!window.storage){
      console.warn("Persistent storage isn't available in this environment — stock & orders will only last this session.");
      hideSyncBanner();
      return;
    }
    try{
      const stockRes = await window.storage.get(STORAGE_KEY_STOCK, true);
      if(stockRes && stockRes.value){
        const stockMap = JSON.parse(stockRes.value);
        PRODUCTS.forEach(p=>{ if(stockMap[p.id]!==undefined) p.stock = stockMap[p.id]; });
      } else {
        await saveStock();
      }
    }catch(e){
      try{ await saveStock(); }catch(e2){ console.error("Could not initialise stock storage", e2); }
    }

    try{
      const ordersRes = await window.storage.get(STORAGE_KEY_ORDERS, true);
      ORDERS = ordersRes && ordersRes.value ? JSON.parse(ordersRes.value) : [];
    }catch(e){
      ORDERS = [];
    }

    renderHomeGrid();
    renderShopGrid();
    hideSyncBanner();
  }

  async function saveStock(){
    if(!window.storage) return;
    const stockMap = {};
    PRODUCTS.forEach(p=>{ stockMap[p.id]=p.stock; });
    try{
      await window.storage.set(STORAGE_KEY_STOCK, JSON.stringify(stockMap), true);
    }catch(e){
      console.error("Could not save stock", e);
      showToast("Couldn't sync stock — saved on this device only");
    }
  }

  async function saveOrders(){
    if(!window.storage) return;
    try{
      await window.storage.set(STORAGE_KEY_ORDERS, JSON.stringify(ORDERS), true);
    }catch(e){
      console.error("Could not save order", e);
      showToast("Order confirmed, but couldn't sync to the shared order list");
    }
  }

  function hideSyncBanner(){
    document.getElementById("syncBanner").classList.add("hide");
  }

  let toastTimer;
  function showToast(text){
    const t = document.getElementById("toast");
    t.textContent = text;
    t.classList.add("show");
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove("show"), 2400);
  }

  function goPage(name){
    showPreloader();
    setTimeout(()=>{
      document.querySelectorAll(".page").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));
      document.getElementById("page-"+name).classList.add("active");
      document.querySelectorAll(".navlinks button").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.page===name));
      document.getElementById("navlinks").classList.remove("open");
      window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:"auto"});
      if(name==="checkout") renderCheckout();
      if(name==="custom") renderCustomPage();
      setTimeout(hidePreloader, 260);
    }, 380);
  }

  function toggleMobileNav(){
    document.getElementById("navlinks").classList.toggle("open");
  }

  // init
  renderHomeGrid();
  renderFilterChips();
  renderShopGrid();
  renderCart();
  renderCustomPage();
  initStorage();

  function showPreloader(){
    const el = document.getElementById("preloader");
    if(!el) return;
    el.classList.remove("hide");
  }
  function hidePreloader(){
    const el = document.getElementById("preloader");
    if(!el) return;
    el.classList.add("hide");
  }
  // first load: show a bit longer, then hide (element stays in the DOM, reused on every page change)
  window.addEventListener("load", ()=> setTimeout(hidePreloader, 1100));
  // fallback in case the load event never fires for some reason
  setTimeout(hidePreloader, 4000);
</script>

</body>
</html>
